note: Two atomic legs, each routing a token from a Uniswap V3 pool to a V2 pool. CVX and TOWER move pool to pool and never touch the actor. A strict reading of Q1 wants a token the actor both receives and sends at net zero. Here the actor's only token is WETH, which nets positive, so the cycle closes through the pools rather than through the actor, and I still call it an arbitrage.
